title: Staged decision graph for safe config rewinds with batching/cache awareness
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a staged decision-graph system that evaluates config changes (batching, caching, quantization, routing policies) against economic and correctness signals and can automatically trigger safe rollbacks or progressive applies. The system must reason about KV cache warming/eviction effects and recommend or execute rollbacks with minimal disruption.

Context: We frequently ship config changes that adjust batching window, cache TTLs, and dynamic routing. These changes affect latency, throughput, cost per token, and cache hit ratios. Existing automated rollbacks are primarily threshold-driven; they don't incorporate workload-aware cache state or cross-metric phase detection (e.g., transient cache churn after a change). This ticket designs and builds a decision graph that: (1) simulates short-run impact using a replay/sandbox, (2) monitors divergence patterns post-apply, (3) applies graduated fallback policies (light revert, partial canary rollback, full revert), and (4) records recommendations back to Optimize engine for future tuning.

Scope: - Data model for decision nodes (metric predicates, weighting, hysteresis window, KV-cache-aware decay factor). - Sandbox replay harness that replays recent traffic to estimate steady-state costs and cache hit rate delta. - Integration with rollout controller to execute staged rollbacks and holdpoints. - Console UI flags for on-call overrides and an audit log entry for each automatic action. - Alerting rules for false-positive suppression (avoid flip-flop).

Non-goals: - Replacing human review for high-risk changes (we'll still require human approval for release-level quantization toggles). - Deep model-specific kernel tuning (handled by separate runtime work).
acceptance_criteria: Decision-graph DAG implemented with pluggable nodes for metric predicates and actions
Sandbox replay produces cost and cache-hit delta estimates within 10% of short-term production observations in 4/5 trials
Automatic staged rollback executed for simulated failing change in QA environment and recorded in audit log
Integrates with rollout controller to pause at holdpoints and supports manual override via Console
End-to-end e2e test that triggers a rollback when combined latency and cost delta exceeds configured threshold
success_metrics: Reduction in manual rollbacks by 45% after rollout of decision-graph
False-positive auto-rollback rate < 3% in first 3 months
Average time-to-detect-and-rollback for cost regressions < 6 minutes
Cache-warmup misprediction reduced (measured by initial cache-hit variance) by 60% for staging workloads
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Chen: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence; highlighted three risk vectors: cache-eviction storms, transient load spikes, and metric noise from sampling. Agreed to prototype on canary cluster first.
2025-02-15 Arjun Patel: Initial schema for decision nodes pushed to branch feature/decision-graph. Node attributes include predicate, severity, hysteresis_ms, kv_decay_factor, recommended_action.

2025-02-18 Priya Singh (SRE): Reviewed schema; requested additional field for 'sampled_metric_window' to make thresholds robust to monitoring sampling. Also requested audit log correlation id for each auto-action.

2025-02-20 Arjun Patel: Sandbox replay harness MVP merged to staging. Replay uses last 12h of request traces and simulates cache TTL changes. Early results show underestimation of cache-warmup time by ~30% — added adjustable warmup_multiplier parameter.
2025-02-22 Design review (Lena Ortiz): UX suggested a three-state UI card (No Action / Recommend / Auto-Execute) with explainer for cache impacts. Added mockups to Figma.

2025-02-24 Performance test: simulated config toggles on canary-3; decision-graph correctly selected partial canary rollback after observing 18% cost increase with 10% latency regression. Logged action to audit and opened PR to rollout-controller. PR number in related_prs.
2025-02-27 Security review request submitted for audit log retention and encryption at rest. Response expected by 2025-03-03.

2025-02-28 Arjun Patel: Moving to integrate with Optimize recommendations API so the decision graph can publish suggested batching TTLs for future experiments. TODO: add integration tests and update acceptance criteria.
